profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ TIDAL Cyber | Python • Backend Systems • Integrations • Cybersecurity
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with 12 years of experience designing and delivering production software across cloud-native platforms and cybersecurity systems. Specialized in Python backend engineering, distributed architectures, REST APIs, and scalable data integrations. Proven technical leadership in architecting AWS infrastructure, establishing engineering standards, implementing Infrastructure as Code, and guiding cross-functional teams through complex product development initiatives. Deep cybersecurity expertise in threat intelligence, adversary emulation, industry standards development, malware analysis, and security automation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and evolved the backend platform, establishing engineering standards for API design, performance, observability, security, and automated testing. Built comprehensive test infrastructure that enabled the team to safely deliver features and refactor core systems to accelerate feature delivery.
• Architected an event-driven AWS platform powering 75+ ETL integrations across cybersecurity products using Lambda, Step Functions, and DynamoDB; increased integration delivery capacity by 5x through reusable components, Docker containerizing, triaging guidance and standardized testing patterns.
• Mentored and led a cross-functional team of 4-6 engineers, instilling Agile best practices that boosted sprint velocity consistently delivering on core roadmap initiatives by making investments in test coverage, code coverage, observability, feature definition, documentation, code reviews, and AI usage.
• Partnered directly with product managers, executive leadership, and enterprise customers  to translate user feedback into actionable technical requirements, optimizing backlog prioritization.
• Increased our automation by expanding our Infrastructure as Code codebase to allow creation of tenant warming pools in hours from days. This allowed sales leads to receive the platform near-instantly.
• Engineered a custom app with AWS Chalice that allowed different team members to obtain general metrics or aggregates-of to answer questions on feature usage.
• Worked on our control center service, expanding its feature set to handle license registration, number of seats, automated content deployments, and integration publishing.
• Engineered CI/CD optimizations on GitHub Actions, automating zero-downtime deployments across multiple AWS regions and cutting deployment cycle times from hours to minutes.

positions.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented adversary TTPs for MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Evaluations,  executing them as a Red Team Operator to evaluate vendor detection capabilities. Built ransomware, C2 servers, and reverse web-shells for the emulation plans. (C++, C#, Go)
• Reverse-engineered and analyzed malware nation-state samples with Ghidra, IDA Pro, and MultiScanner to extract indicator of compromise (IOC) artifacts, authoring threat intelligence reports in STIX, PDF, and rules in YARA and SIGMA that directly informed internal and government defensive engineering and detection pipelines.
Performed dynamic analysis on containerized environments to gather additional visibility on certain malware samples. Used tools like WireShark, FLOSS, Cuckoo, ProcMon and WindDbg to collect, analyze, or debug specific TTP behaviors.
• Represented the organization and government best interest as a Voting Member on the
OASIS Open Committee, directly shaping the specifications for STIX and TAXII 2.0/2.1
JSON-based threat intelligence exchange format and protocol with their Python reference
implementations, schemas, and documentation.
• Built components for the open source file analysis framework MultiScanner,
allowing the community to have an open source option for malware analysis.
• Built components for the open source Python adversary emulation platform CALDERA,
helping the public and private community increase their cybersecurity posture.
positions.insights: Adversary Emulation, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) and +4 skills

positions.title: Intermediate Cybersecurity Engineer
positions.description:
• Built an agnostic Python data markings library that could parse, serialize, and simplify the
marking of XML documents for STIX 1.X documents helping the government and
intelligence community adopt common threat intelligence sharing standard.
• Built SWID Tags XML reference implementation and worked with TagVault to drive public
and private partnerships.
• Built a Java XML DSIG tool that supported up-to XAdES-X that helped protect message
integrity for government and vendors to adopt and protect SWID Tags.
• Built Java reference implementation for CPE 2.3, helped the community and industry
adopt the new standard.

positions.title: Intern Cybersecurity Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered visualization tool with Ruby on Rails and Chart.js that helped analysts spot
metadata modifications on a filesystem.
• Remained as Part-Time on call, refactoring small components or automatic tasks.
